title: SSH client accepts any host key (python)
description: python code installs an SSH host-key policy that accepts every key it is offered (paramiko.AutoAddPolicy). Without a known-hosts check the client cannot tell the bank's server from an interposed one, so the session that carries commands, files and credentials is open to a man in the middle. This lexical rule flags the policy; the reviewer replaces it with a loaded known-hosts file.
remediation: Load and verify the server key against a pinned known-hosts file, for example client.load_system_host_keys() followed by RejectPolicy(). Treat an unknown host key as a failed connection, not as a prompt to continue.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the policy call regardless of whether the target is reachable or trusted by other means.
